Latest News

  • When Should Pediatric Palliative Care Begin?
    Medscape News Europe

    When Should Pediatric Palliative Care Begin?

    Evidence in pediatric cancer and heart disease suggests earlier specialist input may ease symptoms and family stress, while gaps in services and research persist.
    News2 hours ago
    Read Article
  • New ACS Guidelines Take Firmer Stance on PSA Screening
    Medscape Medical News

    New ACS Guidelines Take Firmer Stance on PSA Screening

    With growing confidence that the benefits outweigh the risks, the American Cancer Society now calls for men to have routine prostate cancer screening.
    News1 day ago
    Read Article
  • Dapagliflozin May Reduce Ascites in Patients With Cirrhosis
    Medscape Medical News

    Dapagliflozin May Reduce Ascites in Patients With Cirrhosis

    Dapagliflozin may improve ascites control in patients with cirrhosis and refractory ascites and reduce the need for paracentesis and albumin use.
    News1 day ago
    Read Article
  • NP-Led Referral Pathway Tied to Faster Hepatology Visits
    Medscape Medical News

    NP-Led Referral Pathway Tied to Faster Hepatology Visits

    A nurse practitioner-led referral pathway triggered by abnormal results in a MASLD screening program was linked with a shorter median time to a hepatology visit.
    Clinical Summary1 day ago
    Read Article
  • Earlier Lung Cancer Surgery Linked to Better Survival
    Medscape Medical News

    Earlier Lung Cancer Surgery Linked to Better Survival

    For patients with stage I lung cancer, the time window between diagnosis and the operating room may carry more weight than expected.
    Clinical Summary1 day ago
    Read Article
  • Attacks on Health Workers Hamper Congo Ebola Fight, Africa CDC Warns
    Reuters Health Information

    Attacks on Health Workers Hamper Congo Ebola Fight, Africa CDC Warns

    Attacks on health workers and facilities are increasingly hindering efforts to contain ⁠an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo that has killed more than...
    News1 day ago
    Read Article
  • Most Pernio Cases Idiopathic, Resolve With Conservative Care
    Medscape Medical News

    Most Pernio Cases Idiopathic, Resolve With Conservative Care

    A cold-triggered rash on the toes or fingers usually resolves on its own, but connective tissue disease-linked cases need treatment, a study shows.
    Clinical Summary1 day ago
    Read Article
  • Broad Genomic Testing Tied to Longer Survival in NSCLC
    Medscape Medical News

    Broad Genomic Testing Tied to Longer Survival in NSCLC

    A study examines whether broad-based genomic sequencing before treatment improves survival in advanced non-small cell lung cancer compared with focused biomarker testing.
    Clinical Summary1 day ago
    Read Article
